existing_view_verdict: No existing CUBE/WEIGHT view or p0312 permutation maps the full 16x16 logical K tile to the QK B/WEIGHT physical layout.
minimal_experiment: construct one 16x16 CUBE K tile and its host weight-layout reference
run the proposed reorder task three times with same output and compare bitwise
extend to four heads and verify no cross-head overlap
only after bitwise pass, wire QKV output and QK consumer in one graph

new_primitive_contract.acceptance: bitwise equal to host K^T/layout reference for one head; then 4 heads; then QKV->reorder->QK producer chain
new_primitive_contract.grouping: one 16x16 head per task; a grouped emit may cover 4/12 heads in one submit
new_primitive_contract.sync: one PPU/DMA task or a copy command with explicit source/dest BO and 16-byte alignment

not_done: No hardware reorder command exists in the current custom-ops set; this tool does not claim a device implementation.
weight_index: n*32+k for n,k<16 (within the 1024-element padded BO)
